notes.title: Measuring the Problem Firsthand: First-Person Dueling
notes.content:
In Quill > Pistol, every duel is a math problem—and precision is everything.

To fully immerse you in The Mathematician’s world, I’ve shifted the entire game to a first-person perspective. Now, whether you’re preparing calculations, sizing up your opponent, or staring down the barrel of a pistol, you’ll experience every moment through his own eyes. Today’s spotlight is on the revamped Height Measurement mini game, which shows off how this new perspective brings the tension and precision of duel prep to life.

We’ve all heard “walking a mile in someone’s shoes.” In Quill > Pistol, you’re too busy measuring people and trying not to die in his.

The new screenshot showcases the first-person hand mechanics you’ll use to estimate your opponent’s height—a crucial part of calculating your shot. The closer your estimate, the better your odds of landing a hit. Miscalculate, and… well, The Mathematician won’t be needing those shoes much longer.

Check out the first-person mechanics in action!

More updates soon as the duel system takes shape.
